name: flexiple-ai-hr-monorepo
description: Flexiple AI Recruiter - The Sourcing Refinement Loop Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "yarn workspace backend dev" "yarn workspace frontend dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "yarn workspace backend start:prod" "yarn workspace frontend start"
scripts.build: yarn workspace backend build && yarn workspace frontend build
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace backend typecheck && yarn workspace frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: yarn workspace backend lint && yarn workspace frontend typecheck
